acceptance: Posting a valid URL returns the created link with an id and a `savedAt` timestamp.
The saved link appears in the user's library on the next library fetch.
An invalid or empty URL is rejected with a validation error and nothing is persisted.
items.rationale: Saving a link is the core act of the product; without durable capture nothing else matters (charter: vision).
items.statement: WHEN a logged-in user submits a URL THE SYSTEM SHALL persist it as a saved link in that user's library and confirm the save.

acceptance: Adding a tag to a link makes the link appear in a by-tag query for that tag.
Removing a tag from a link removes the link from that tag's by-tag query.
A link may carry zero or more tags; tag names are case-insensitive and de-duplicated.
items.rationale: Tags are the only organizing mechanism (folders are a non-goal); retrieval-by-tag is how the collector finds anything again.
items.statement: WHEN a user adds or removes a tag on a saved link THE SYSTEM SHALL update that link's tag set and make the link retrievable by each of its current tags.

acceptance: Publishing a collection returns a share token whose URL renders the collection read-only to an anonymous visitor.
Links added to the collection after publishing appear at the share URL without re-publishing.
After revocation the share URL returns a 404/gone and exposes no collection data.
items.rationale: Sharing a curated set without exposing the whole library is the curator's headline job (charter: success criteria).
items.statement: WHEN a curator publishes a collection THE SYSTEM SHALL generate a stable read-only share link that resolves to the collection's current members, and SHALL stop resolving once the curator revokes it.

acceptance: p95 latency of the save endpoint is below 300ms in the load-test report at 50 requests/second.
p95 latency of the library-list endpoint is below 300ms under the same load.
items.rationale: The charter promises a save that feels instant and a library that loads under a second; the API budget protects that experience.
items.statement: WHILE serving an authenticated library or save request THE SYSTEM SHALL return a response in under 300 milliseconds at the 95th percentile under nominal load.

acceptance: A request for another user's link, tag, or unpublished collection is denied with a 403/404 and leaks no data.
Only a published collection's share token grants anonymous read access, and only to that collection.
items.rationale: A personal library is private by definition; the only public surface is an explicitly published collection (REQ-0003). This is the trust boundary the whole product rests on.
items.statement: THE SYSTEM SHALL ensure every saved link, tag, and unpublished collection is accessible only to the user who owns it, and SHALL deny all cross-user access by default.
